about: A function's own format is bundled as <function>__<format>, a key no format the package uses may have (chapter 7 § 7.2.4). The function sign has its own format excerpt; the plan returns the package format sign__excerpt. Invalid: sign's node draft returns excerpt. Valid: draft returns plaintext, and excerpt is not bundled.
sentences: Function 'sign' format 'excerpt' is compiled as 'sign__excerpt', which the package already uses: rename one.
